entries.title: A held batch says who is working on it
entries.body: When a batch of your approved changes is held, the Batches panel and Settings now say who has the next step: the crewmate repairing it, with its latest report, a rule where your project lives, you, or no one yet. While a repair is working on it, nothing asks you to answer. Try again and Send back stay in Settings under Answer it yourself.

picture.alt: The Batches panel showing a held batch whose repair is working on it, with the repair's key, its latest report and the failed check on one line
